title: 281. Sektorrotation är veckans ord
summary_md:
# 281. Sektorrotation är veckans ord

**Feed**: aktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-11-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Aktiespararnas Aktiepodden (Lars Frick and Oliver) look at Swedish macro. SEB has cut its 2027 GDP forecast from 2.9% to 2.5% because of weaker consumption, while industry, exports and public finances stay strong. The hosts describe a sector rotation out of AI and Nasdaq into defensive sectors such as healthcare, telecom, banks and property, with OMXSPI hitting an all-time high. In company news they question how durable Synsam's Lifestyle subscription model is, call Meko weak again, end up cautiously positive on Munters as a higher-risk pick after its capital markets day, and see New Wave as a long-term story whose margin recovery will take until 2027-2028.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

CMD set out the margin path (data 10%→14-16%), stricter adjusted EBITA definition, low multiples, 100% analyst buy, strong order intake; the stock lags.

#### Reasoning

Oliver ends up positive: internal efficiency measures could lift margins even if the 14-16% target is missed. A FoodTech divestment could cut debt and multiples are low. Lars is not convinced the CMD answered the doubts and says the burden of proof is still on Munters. He sees it as interesting for a high-risk part of a portfolio, but it needs patience because investment-heavy years may delay the margin journey.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the data segment margin does not improve
- if data center competition keeps getting harder
- if customers sharply cut cooling demand
- if high investment and debt keep weighing on profits

> *"Ja, jag landar ändå i att vara positiv."*

---

### ⛔ MEKO — Meko | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Weak report, stock down ~15%, negative organic growth in all markets, low-margin player facing price pressure.

#### Reasoning

Both hosts say they are not tempted to invest. The CEO has talked about competition and price pressure for many quarters. Even a cost-saving consumer environment that should help an aftermarket player has not translated into growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth turns positive and margins recover broadly

> *"Men en som varken du eller jag kanske vänder oss till när det gäller att vara sugen på att investera, det är ju Meko"*

---

### ⛔ SYNSAM — Synsam | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cheap (~11x EBIT, ~4% yield) and growing well, but rising Lifestyle churn makes the business model hard to rely on.

#### Reasoning

Oliver is split: the valuation is attractive, but he cannot judge how durable the subscription model is and prefers other stocks. Lars thinks the subscription is overpriced and customers will see through it, and calls rising churn a warning flag.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Lifestyle churn stabilises and subscription economics prove durable

> *"Det gör att jag hellre vänder mig till många av de andra aktierna som finns på Stockholmsbörsen."*

---

### 🟠 NEWA-B — New Wave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Investment cycle and dilutive acquisitions push the margin recovery to 2027-2028; patient investors who trust Torsten may be rewarded.

#### Reasoning

Moving in the right direction but not convincing. Underlying margin is flat year on year, organic growth is low and investment stays high. The hosts note the stock was flat before 2019-2020 and then rose sharply, so long-term investors may do well.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth stays low
- if the margin is not fixed by 2027-2028

> *"Orkar man vara lite långsiktig och lita på Torsten, så kan det säkert bli bra."*

---
